title: We did great biz yesterday
html_source: Young Milly writes in short abrupt sentences and shortens words…sort of like texting in 1904.

anchor.prefix: I got mummy's lovely box of creams and am writing. They are lovely. I am getting on swimming in the photo business now. Mr Coghlan took one of me and Mrs will send when developed.
anchor.suffix: . Fair day and all the beef to the heels were in. We are going to lough Owel on Monday with a few friends to make a scrap picnic. Give my love to mummy and to yourself a big kiss a
